ctx.x: Well anyway, Roy says, "Smack," he says, "now you know we went to Europe, and I always have been a lover of a great guitarist named Joe Pass, and Joe can play. I still say this." And I know the history pretty well on Joe, and they toured Europe with Roy and Jaws on this thing, and had sessions, and Roy mentioned that, "Yeah, he can play, but he ain't going to play it all four beats. When he get ready,
he going to just lay out or going to get in your way, you know, when you're playing, one of those things.
